subject: [RUN DONE] rl4cv expt20: STOPPED at trainer log-probability mismatch gate
body:
Experiment 20 is STOPPED at the mandatory trainer log-probability mismatch gate. The failed-gate closure is published, with a ready-for-review pull request; it has not been merged.

The two-update trainer smoke failed at a maximum 22,654/864,717 tokens = 2.61982% mismatch [n/a, n/a], p-val=n/a, versus the runbook limit of at most 1% (absolute log-probability tolerance 0.05). These are exact observed token counts, not independent-token inference. Item response theory (IRT) prompt selection's effect on held-out validation remains unmeasured. The adopted custom optimizer loop also deviates from the required GRPOTrainer/NeMo backend; that limitation is recorded explicitly. No gate was weakened or downstream phase launched.

All adopted GPU jobs ended naturally. Preserved: all 4,312 unique calibration cells (539 tasks x 8), zero missing generations, all calibration score fields blank; all 256 smoke rollouts; native gate receipts; diagnostic plots; and paths/hashes for 2,027 remote raw/diagnostic files. Calibration produced 25,821,971 tokens, with 940/4,312 token-capped generations. The test split stayed closed; unavailable validation learning curves and treatment comparisons are documented.

Final cost: Phase 0 7.2358/10 GPU-hours; trainer smoke including infrastructure failures 0.5900/15; main 0/130; evaluation 0/80; total 7.8258/200 GPU-hours; API spend $0. Verification passed: make test, 1,415 passed, 17 skipped, 6 subtests passed, 3 warnings; shell/retry fixtures, artifact hashes, full cell denominator and allocation reconciliation passed.
